status: Phase 5 is a post-hoc supplementary comparison: the QaTa test split was already evaluated and seen in Phases 2 and 3. It is not an independent confirmation. Phase 4 remains STOP (38eb77d); no spatial experiment.

scope.not_used: C1, C3a-C3c, MosMedData+ (no new baseline on them)
scope.no_training: no segmentation training, no new split, D-Gate and LR-Gate unchanged
scope.test_rows: 206,595 rows = 3 models x 3 seeds x (C0 2113 + C2 2113 + C4, C5, C6 2081 targets x 3 donors each); asserted before any output

inputs.rows_and_probabilities: as src/phase3/features.py passes() / one_run(): LANG C0, C4-C6 from runs/phase2/<split>/<method>/QaTa-COV19/seed<k>/probs_<cond>_<variant>.npz; validation C2 from the Phase 3 rerun runs/phase3/val/lang/...; test C2 from runs/phase2/test (amendment A1); IMG from runs/phase3/<split>/img/nnunet/QaTa-COV19/seed<k>/probs.npz; row keys dataset, method, seed, sample_id, condition, variant_id, donor_sample_id
inputs.binary_masks: B = P > 0.5 (src/lgms/metrics.py THRESHOLD, strict); on test every row asserts packbits(P > 0.5) == the archived mask (LANG masks_<cond>_<variant>.npz, IMG masks.npz)
inputs.ground_truth: test masks read as in the Phase 2 test inference: lgms.data.load_split_arrays('QaTa-COV19', 'test') under slurm/env_phase1.sh
inputs.existing_tables: results/phase3_reliability_features[_test].csv.gz, results/phase3_feature_labels[_test].csv.gz, results/phase2_test_per_case.csv.gz, results/phase3_img_test_per_case.csv.gz, results/phase3_dgate_thresholds.json, results/phase3_lr_artifacts.json, results/phase3_fallback_selection.csv, results/phase3_gate_partitions.csv, results/phase3_computational_cost.csv

sdc.formula: SDC = 2 * sum(P_lang * B_lang) / [sum(P_lang) + sum(B_lang)], float64, B_lang = P_lang > 0.5 (the scored LANG mask)
sdc.empty: SDC = 0 when the denominator is 0 (P_lang all zero; then B_lang is empty)
sdc.source: Borges, Pacheco, Silva, Soft Dice Confidence, Machine Learning 2026, DOI 10.1007/s10994-026-07096-w; arXiv 2402.10665 v6 eq. 22 (SDC(0,0) = 0)
sdc.note: the paper's example binarisation is p >= gamma; here, as the plan requires, the evaluator's scored mask P > 0.5 is used (they differ only at pixels exactly equal to 0.5)
sdc.rule: fall back to B_img if SDC < tau, else keep B_lang

sdc_threshold.per: one tau per language model x seed; QaTa GATE_CAL only (validation)
sdc_threshold.rows: as src/phase3/gates.py main(): features and labels merged one-to-one on the keys, QaTa only, conditions C0, C2, C4, C5, C6, then partition == GATE_CAL per model x seed
sdc_threshold.selection: src/phase3/gates.py calibrate(cal, 'neg_sdc') with neg_sdc = -SDC, unchanged: candidates {-inf, +inf} and every distinct neg_sdc on these rows; rule neg_sdc > t; Delta(c) by donors -> images -> groups (nested_weights) with C0 / C2 on all eligible GATE_CAL images and C4-C6 on S_CAL (targets eligible for C4, C5 and C6); objective mean Delta(C4, C5, C6); feasible if all five Delta >= -0.005; ties (<= 1e-12) to the higher t, i.e. fewer fallbacks; if the best feasible objective is <= 0: t = +inf (never fall back)
sdc_threshold.reporting: tau = -t in SDC units (t = +inf -> tau = -inf, never fall back); stored at full precision; calibration fallback rates as calibrate() (switched rows / rows), as in results/phase3_lr_calibration.csv

fixed_average.formula: P_avg = 0.5 * P_lang + 0.5 * P_img (float32 maps as stored); B_avg = P_avg > 0.5 (a pixel exactly 0.5 is background)
fixed_average.no_tuning: no weight or threshold is tuned

strategies.SDC-Fallback: B_img if SDC < tau(model, seed) else B_lang; its per-case metrics are those of the selected LANG or IMG row (same masks, same evaluator)

aggregation.tables: as src/phase3/evaluate_gates.py image_weighted(): per seed, donors averaged within image, then images; mean +- SD over the 3 seeds; fallback_rate image-weighted the same way
aggregation.paired: as src/phase3/stats_phase3.py group_differences(): donor differences within image and seed -> seeds within image -> images within group (Phase 2 / Phase 3 groups) -> equal-weight groups
aggregation.ci: stats_phase3.t_over_groups(): mean and 95% t-interval over groups (ddof 1); no p-values are output

comparisons.main_post_hoc: LR-Gate - SDC-Fallback and LR-Gate - Fixed Average under C4, C5, C6 for each language model (post-hoc supplementary, not a confirmatory family)
comparisons.clean_cost: strategy - LANG under C0 and C2 for IMG, D-Gate, LR-Gate, SDC-Fallback, Fixed Average, with the 95% CI and the -0.005 development margin shown; no equivalence or safety claim

mixed_reliability.population: the common QaTa test targets eligible for C4, C5 and C6 (2081 images, 472 groups); C0 restricted to the same targets
mixed_reliability.D: D(C) = group-weighted mean Dice (donors -> seeds -> images -> groups) per model x strategy on that population
mixed_reliability.wrong: D_wrong = [D(C4) + D(C5) + D(C6)] / 3 (equal-weight benchmark stress-test mixture, not a real error distribution)
mixed_reliability.expected: E(p) = (1 - p) D(C0) + p D_wrong; curves at p = 0.00, 0.01, ..., 1.00 for plotting only
mixed_reliability.crossover: for A vs B: delta_clean = D_A(C0) - D_B(C0), delta_wrong = D_A(wrong) - D_B(wrong); if delta_wrong != delta_clean, p* = -delta_clean / (delta_wrong - delta_clean), reported if 0 <= p* <= 1; otherwise (or delta_wrong == delta_clean) 'none'
mixed_reliability.pairs: LR-Gate, SDC-Fallback and Fixed Average each versus always-LANG and versus always-IMG; and the range of p in [0, 1] where the strategy is better than both fixed choices
mixed_reliability.sensitivity: crossovers only, with D_wrong replaced by D(C4), D(C5) or D(C6) alone
mixed_reliability.caveat: a crossover is not a clinical threshold
mixed_reliability.strategies: LANG, IMG, LR-Gate, SDC-Fallback, Fixed Average only: the plan's Task 5.4 report items and Figure 2 list these five, so D-Gate does not enter Task 5.4 (curves, crossovers, better-than-both ranges); D-Gate stays in results/phase5_test_results.csv and in the C0 / C2 cost comparison

compute.source: results/phase3_computational_cost.csv (job 391; validation, first 64 sorted QaTa ids, seed 1001, C0): mean_ms of 'LANG only' per model and of 'IMG only'
compute.formula: LR-Gate, D-Gate, Fixed Average: LANG_time + IMG_time; SDC-Fallback: LANG_time + fallback_rate x IMG_time, fallback_rate = the image-weighted SDC fallback rate of the test results table (mean of the 3 seeds), per model x condition; approximation (score overhead ignored)

files: results/phase5_test_per_case.csv.gz (keys, SDC, SDC-Fallback switch, Fixed Average dice / miou / hd95 / assd / empty)
figures: reports/figures/phase5/fig1_strategies.png: Dice under C0, C4, C5, C6 for LANG, IMG, LR-Gate, SDC-Fallback, Fixed Average, three models

reports/figures/phase5/fig2_mixed_reliability.png: expected Dice versus p for the same five strategies (equal C4/C5/C6 mixture), LR-Gate crossovers with always-LANG and always-IMG marked when they exist

order: plan -> spec, code and synthetic tests -> SDC calibration on GATE_CAL (Slurm) -> freeze document and artifact sha256 manifest (Slurm) -> one test computation (Slurm) after checking the manifest, a clean tree and HEAD on origin/main -> figures and results report
after_freeze: the test computation runs once; no rule, threshold or gate is changed after the Phase 5 test comparison is seen

programs.test_split: src/phase5/compute_test_split.py (slurm/phase5_test.slurm; named so that it is never collected as a unit test)
